role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Commissions Payable
role.documentation: Increase (Decrease) in Commissions Payable

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Financing Asset
role.documentation: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Financing Asset

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fees Receivable
role.documentation: Increase (Decrease) in Fees Receivable

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Receivable
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in income taxes receivable, which represents the amount due from tax authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes paid.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Prepaid expenses and other current assets
role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Stockholders' Equity [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Temporary Equity [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
role.documentation: Adjustment to retained earnings for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock that is classified as temporary equity.

role.documentation: Incremental Term Loans

role.documentation: Initial Public Offering Transaction Costs

Intangible Assets Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for all or part of the information related to intangible assets.

role.label: Intangible Assets, Finite-Lived, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for finite-lived intangible assets. This accounting policy also might address: (1) the amortization method used; (2) the useful lives of such assets; and (3) how the entity assesses and measures impairment of such assets.

role.label: Intangible Assets, Gross (Excluding Goodwill)
role.documentation: Amount before accumulated amortization of intangible assets, excluding goodwill.

role.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
role.documentation: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

role.label: Interest Expense, Long-Term Debt
role.documentation: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

role.label: Interest Expense, Nonoperating
role.documentation: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

role.label: Interest Paid, Including Capitalized Interest, Operating and Investing Activities [Abstract]
Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
role.documentation: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

role.label: Interest Payable, Current
role.documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

role.label: Internal Use Software, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for costs incurred when both (1) the software is acquired, internally developed, or modified solely to meet the entity's internal needs, and (2) during the software's development or modification, no substantive plan exists or is being developed to market the software externally.

role.label: Investment Income, Interest
role.documentation: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

role.label: Lessee, Leases [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for leasing arrangement entered into by lessee.

role.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Monthly Payment
role.documentation: Lessee, Operating Lease, Monthly Payment

role.label: Liabilities
role.documentation: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

role.terseLabel: Liabilities, Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock and Stockholders’ Deficit
role.label: Liabilities [Abstract]

role.totalLabel: Total liabilities, redeemable, convertible preferred stock, and stockholders’ deficit
role.label: Liabilities and Equity
role.documentation: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

role.label: Liabilities, Current
role.documentation: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

role.label: Line of Credit Facility [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
role.documentation: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

role.label: Line of Credit Facility, Minimum Incremental Borrowing Capacity
role.documentation: Line of Credit Facility, Minimum Incremental Borrowing Capacity

role.label: Line of Credit Facility [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about short-term and long-term contractual arrangements with lender under which borrowing can occur up to maximum amount. Includes, but is not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit, and revolving credit arrangement.

role.label: Line of Credit [Member]
role.documentation: A contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time, and under which borrowings outstanding may be either short-term or long-term, depending upon the particulars.

role.label: Local Phone Number
role.documentation: Local phone number for entity.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
role.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
role.documentation: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

role.label: Long-Term Line of Credit, Noncurrent
role.documentation: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the noncurrent portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Type [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of long-term debt.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Type [Domain]
role.documentation: Type of long-term debt arrangement, such as notes, line of credit, commercial paper, asset-based financing, project financing, letter of credit financing. These are debt arrangements that originally required repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company, if longer.

role.terseLabel: MNPI Disclosure Timed for Compensation Value
role.label: MNPI Disclosure Timed for Compensation Value [Flag]

role.documentation: Nature of Business and Basis of Presentation (Details) [Table]

role.totalLabel: Net cash used in financing activities
role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

role.totalLabel: Net cash used in investing activities
role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

role.totalLabel: Net cash provided by operating activities
role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

role.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
role.documentation: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

role.totalLabel: Net income available to common stockholders
role.terseLabel: Net income (loss) available to common stockholders
role.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
role.documentation: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

role.terseLabel: Recently Adopted Accounting Pronouncements and Recent Accounting Pronouncements Not Yet Adopted
role.label: New Accounting Pronouncements, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy pertaining to new accounting pronouncements that may impact the entity's financial reporting. Includes, but is not limited to, quantification of the expected or actual impact.

role.terseLabel: Non-PEO NEO Average Compensation Actually Paid Amount
role.label: Non-PEO NEO Average Compensation Actually Paid Amount

role.terseLabel: Non-PEO NEO Average Total Compensation Amount
role.label: Non-PEO NEO Average Total Compensation Amount
Number of Operating Segments
role.documentation: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the same enterprise), (b) whose operating results are regularly reviewed by the enterprise's chief operating decision maker to make decisions about resources to be allocated to the segment and assess its performance, and (c) for which discrete financial information is available. An operating segment may engage in business activities for which it has yet to earn revenues, for example, start-up operations may be operating segments before earning revenues.

role.label: Number of Reportable Segments
role.documentation: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

role.terseLabel: Number of voting rights per share
role.label: Number Of Voting Rights Per Share
role.documentation: Number Of Voting Rights Per Share

role.label: Operating Expenses
role.documentation: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

role.label: Operating Income (Loss)
role.documentation: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

role.label: Operating Lease, Expense
role.documentation: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

role.label: Organization, Consolidation and Presentation of Financial Statements [Abstract]
Payments for Repurchase of Equity
role.documentation: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.

role.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
role.documentation: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

role.negatedLabel: Payment of deferred financing fees and prepayment penalty
role.label: Payments of Financing Costs
role.documentation: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

role.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
role.documentation: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

role.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
role.documentation: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

role.label: Payments to Develop Software
role.documentation: The cash outflow associated with the development or modification of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

role.terseLabel: Peer Group Total Shareholder Return Amount
role.label: Peer Group Total Shareholder Return Amount
Performance Shares [Member]
role.documentation: Share-based payment arrangement awarded for meeting performance target.

role.label: Plan Name [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by plan name for share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Plan Name [Domain]
role.documentation: Plan name for share-based payment arrangement.

role.negatedLabel: Less: allocation to participating preferred stock
role.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
role.documentation: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

role.label: Premiums Receivable, Net
role.documentation: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, net of the allowance for doubtful accounts.

role.terseLabel: Prepaid expenses and other current assets
role.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
role.documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering
role.documentation: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

role.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
role.documentation: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

role.terseLabel: Issuance of redeemable, convertible preferred stock, net of issuance costs
role.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
role.documentation: The cash inflow from issuance of callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security at the option of the issuer or the holder.

role.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
role.documentation: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

role.label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

role.terseLabel: Contributed capital, stockholder reimbursement of IPO transaction costs
role.label: Proceeds from Reimbursement of Initial Public Offering Transaction Costs
role.documentation: Proceeds from Reimbursement of Initial Public Offering Transaction Costs

role.verboseLabel: Proceeds from exercise of stock options
role.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Reclassification of unamortized deferred financing fees to deferred financing asset
role.label: Reclassification Of Unamortized Deferred Financing Fees To Deferred Financing Asset
role.documentation: Reclassification Of Unamortized Deferred Financing Fees To Deferred Financing Asset

role.label: Recovery of Erroneously Awarded Compensation Disclosure [Line Items]

role.negatedLabel: Cash dividend paid on redeemable preferred stock
role.terseLabel: Less: Cash dividend paid on redeemable preferred stock
role.label: Redeemable Preferred Stock Dividends
role.documentation: Dividends paid to preferred stock holders that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

role.label: Related and Nonrelated Parties [Domain]
role.documentation: Related and nonrelated parties. Related party includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, other entity for which investment is accounted for under equity method, trust for benefit of employee, principal owner, management, and member of immediate family, and other party that may be prevented from pursuing separate interests because of control, significant influence, or ownership interest.

role.label: Related Party Transaction [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Related Party Transaction, Purchases from Related Party
role.documentation: Purchases during the period (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

role.label: Related and Nonrelated Parties [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by related and nonrelated parties. Related party includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, other entity for which investment is accounted for under equity method, trust for benefit of employee, principal owner, management, and member of immediate family, and other party that may be prevented from pursuing separate interests because of control, significant influence, or ownership interest.

role.label: Related Party Transactions Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for related party transactions. Examples of related party transactions include transactions between (a) a parent company and its subsidiary; (b) subsidiaries of a common parent; (c) and entity and its principal owners; and (d) affiliates.

role.label: Repayments of Lines of Credit
role.documentation: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

role.label: Repayments of Long-Term Debt
role.documentation: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Repayments of Secured Debt
role.documentation: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

role.label: Restatement Does Not Require Recovery [Text Block]
Restricted Cash
role.documentation: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

role.label: Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) [Member]
role.documentation: Share instrument which is convertible to stock or an equivalent amount of cash, after a specified period of time or when specified performance conditions are met.

role.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

role.label: Retained Earnings [Member]
role.documentation: Accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

role.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
role.documentation: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

role.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for revenue from contract with customer.

role.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure of revenue from contract with customer to transfer good or service and to transfer nonfinancial asset. Includes, but is not limited to, disaggregation of revenue, credit loss recognized from contract with customer, judgment and change in judgment related to contract with customer, and asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer. Excludes insurance and lease contracts.

role.label: Revolving Credit Facility [Member]
role.documentation: Arrangement in which loan proceeds can continuously be obtained following repayments, but the total amount borrowed cannot exceed a specified maximum amount.

role.terseLabel: Sale of stock, number of shares issued (in shares)
role.label: Sale of Stock, Number of Shares Issued in Transaction
role.documentation: The number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee per stock transaction.

role.terseLabel: Offering cost reimbursement, maximum percent of gross proceeds
role.label: Sale of Stock, Offering Cost Reimbursement, Percent of Gross Proceeds, Maximum
role.documentation: Sale of Stock, Offering Cost Reimbursement, Percent of Gross Proceeds, Maximum

role.terseLabel: Sale of stock, offering price (in dollars per share)
role.label: Sale of Stock, Price Per Share
role.documentation: Per share amount received by subsidiary or equity investee for each share of common stock issued or sold in the stock transaction.

role.label: Sales Commissions and Fees
role.documentation: Primarily represents commissions incurred in the period based upon the sale by commissioned employees or third parties of the entity's goods or services, and fees for sales assistance or product enhancements performed by third parties (such as a distributor or value added reseller).

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share
role.label: Schedule of Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS because to do so would increase EPS amounts or decrease loss per share amounts for the period presented, by antidilutive securities.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Paid Cash Taxes, Net of Refunds
role.label: Schedule of Cash Flow, Supplemental Disclosures [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of supplemental cash flow information for the periods presented.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Roll Forward of Common Stock Issued and Outstanding
role.label: Schedule of Common Stock Outstanding Roll Forward [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the change in common stock outstanding.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Components of Income Tax Expense
role.label: Schedule of Components of Income Tax Expense (Benefit) [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the components of income tax expense attributable to continuing operations for each year presented including, but not limited to: current tax expense (benefit), deferred tax expense (benefit), investment tax credits, government grants, the benefits of operating loss carryforwards, tax expense that results from allocating certain tax benefits either directly to contributed capital or to reduce goodwill or other noncurrent intangible assets of an acquired entity, adjustments of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity, and adjustments of the beginning-of-the-year balances of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstances that causes a change in judgment about the realizability of the related deferred tax asset in future years.

role.label: Schedule of Debt [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of information pertaining to short-term and long-debt instruments or arrangements, including but not limited to identification of terms, features, collateral requirements and other information necessary to a fair presentation.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Components of Deferred Income Tax Assets and Liabilities
role.label: Schedule of Deferred Tax Assets and Liabilities [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the components of net deferred tax asset or liability recognized in an entity's statement of financial position, including the following: the total of all deferred tax liabilities, the total of all deferred tax assets, the total valuation allowance recognized for deferred tax assets.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Computation of Basic and Dilutive Earnings (Loss) Per Share
role.label: Schedule of Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of an entity's basic and diluted earnings per share calculations, including a reconciliation of numerators and denominators of the basic and diluted per-share computations for income from continuing operations.

role.terseLabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic, by Common Class, Including Two-Class Method [Table]
role.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic, by Common Class, Including Two-Class Method [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about basic earnings per share by class of stock. Includes, but is not limited to, two-class method.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Effective Tax Rates Reconciliation
role.label: Schedule of Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the reconciliation using percentage or dollar amounts of the reported amount of income tax expense attributable to continuing operations for the year to the amount of income tax expense that would result from applying domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes indefinite-lived intangible asset.

role.label: Schedule of Finite-Lived Intangible Assets [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life, by either major class or business segment.

role.label: Related Party Transaction [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about related party transaction.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award [Table]
role.label: Schedule of Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Summary of Restricted Stock Unit Activity
role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock Unit, Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the number and weighted-average grant date fair value for restricted stock units that were outstanding at the beginning and end of the year, and the number of restricted stock units that were granted, vested, or forfeited during the year.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure for stock option plans. Includes, but is not limited to, outstanding awards at beginning and end of year, grants, exercises, forfeitures, and weighted-average grant date fair value.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Weighted Average Assumptions Used for Black-Scholes Model Valuation of Stock Options
role.label: Schedule of Share-Based Payment Award, Stock Options, Valuation Assumptions [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the significant assumptions used during the year to estimate the fair value of stock options, including, but not limited to: (a) expected term of share options and similar instruments, (b) expected volatility of the entity's shares, (c) expected dividends, (d) risk-free rate(s), and (e) discount for post-vesting restrictions.

role.label: Stock, Class of Stock [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about stock by class. Includes, but is not limited to, common, convertible, and preferred stocks.

role.terseLabel: Summary of Expected Amortization of Intangible Assets
role.label: Schedule of Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Future Amortization Expense [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the amount of amortization expense expected to be recorded in succeeding fiscal years for finite-lived intangible assets.

role.label: Secured Debt [Member]
role.documentation: Collateralized debt obligation backed by, for example, but not limited to, pledge, mortgage or other lien on the entity's assets.

role.label: Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) [Member]
role.documentation: Interest rate at which bank can borrow U.S. dollar overnight while posting U.S. Treasury bond as collateral.

role.label: Title of 12(b) Security
role.documentation: Title of a 12(b) registered security.

role.label: Security Exchange Name
role.documentation: Name of the Exchange on which a security is registered.

role.label: Segment Reporting Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for reporting segments including data and tables. Reportable segments include those that meet any of the following quantitative thresholds a) it's reported revenue, including sales to external customers and intersegment sales or transfers is 10 percent or more of the combined revenue, internal and external, of all operating segments b) the absolute amount of its reported profit or loss is 10 percent or more of the greater, in absolute amount of 1) the combined reported profit of all operating segments that did not report a loss or 2) the combined reported loss of all operating segments that did report a loss c) its assets are 10 percent or more of the combined assets of all operating segments.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
role.documentation: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Requisite Service Period
role.documentation: Estimated period over which an employee is required to provide service in exchange for the equity-based payment award, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Vesting Period
role.documentation: Period over which grantee's right to exercise award under share-based payment arrangement is no longer contingent on satisfaction of service or performance condition, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, combination of market, performance or service condition.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
